svg.title: Rotary dryer cross-section with lifting flights
svg.text: ⊗ hot gas flows axially along the drum (into the page)
1 Convection: hot gas flows through the falling
curtain; every particle surface is exposed (dominant)
2 Conduction: solids sliding on the hot shell
3 Radiation from the hot shell and flights
(and hot combustion gas) to the solids
4 Mixing: repeated lifting turns the bed over,
renewing the surface and evening temperatures
Flights lift solids from the bed and
shower them across the full gas stream.
